summary: Pre-market view. The composite risk score is unchanged at 44.17 and the regime still reads goldilocks, but the composition underneath moved: the front end of the curve eased 5 bp to 4.71 while the 10Y held at 4.96, steepening 10Y/2Y to 0.25, with the real rate at 2.63 in the 99.84 percentile and the 10Y in the 99.6. The last completed US session settled on 2026-09-23 as a broad AI-hardware de-rate: semis -1.9428, data centers -1.9656, networking -1.1428, robotics -3.4298, and only 6 of 22 sectors higher, with NVDA -1.4681, AVGO -2.6197, MU -2.215 and AMD -1.4685. The new Asia input is the CN close, where all 11 tracked A-share AI names fell, the worst 688525.sh at -5.245. Overnight, New York Fed's Williams called another hike by year-end reasonable and FedWatch now implies 4.205 against a delivered EFFR of 3.88, while spot gold fell to 4250; a VIX of 14.21 and a HY OAS of 2.68 show credit and volatility still refusing to price the rate constraint.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The discount-rate block remains the binding constraint: the real rate is 2.63 in the 99.84 percentile and the 10Y is 4.96 in the 99.6, lifting the macro dimension to 68.48.

The policy path is being re-priced hawkish: New York Fed's Williams said another hike by year-end is reasonable, and FedWatch implies 4.205 on a hike action against a delivered EFFR of 3.88, into the FOMC on 2026-09-28.
The last completed US session de-rated AI hardware across the complex: semis -1.9428, data centers -1.9656, networking -1.1428 and robotics -3.4298, with only 6 of 22 sectors higher.
The liquidity cushion is thin: reverse repo is 0.461 in the 3.53 percentile with a risk score of 92.93, even as reserves rose to 3013794 and the Fed balance sheet edged to 6746548.
Equity structure keeps deteriorating from a low base: new lows at 0.0645 exceed new highs at 0.0258, semis relative is -10.6632 and small caps -9.6929, with only 0.6 of the market above its MA200.

supporting_signals.claim: The CN close was the day's clearest risk-off reading: all 11 tracked A-share AI names closed lower, from 002156.sz at -2.8344 to 688525.sh at -5.245.
Crypto extended the de-risking: BTC fell -2.94998 to 83241.0, with ETH at -3.42674 and SOL at -3.69597.
US AI mega-caps closed heavy: NVDA -1.4681, AVGO -2.6197, MU -2.215 and AMD -1.4685, with only TSLA higher at 0.322.
Money rotated out of AI infrastructure into software and industrials: enterprise software rose 1.2646, industrial automation 1.58 and cybersecurity 0.8924, the best 3 of the 22 sectors.
The 2Y eased 5 bp to 4.71 while the 10Y held at 4.96, steepening 10Y/2Y to 0.25.

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility is not confirming: the VIX eased to 14.21, the 15.56 percentile, with realized vol at 10.871 and the volatility dimension the calmest block at 14.59.
Credit barely moved: HY OAS is 2.68 in the 8.65 percentile and IG OAS 0.77 in the 13.63, both far from stress levels.
Dollar strength is not broad: the dollar index is 119.5133, only the 30.2 percentile, with the yuan at 6.6975 and the yen at 156.87.
The US equity damage was concentrated, not broad: TSLA rose 0.322 and memory was marginally positive at 0.0915, so the de-rate was not a blanket risk-off.
Model confidence is high at 0.9059 with full input coverage, so the caution reading is well-supported rather than a low-quality artifact.

what_changed_today: The rates vintage advanced to 2026-09-22 and the front end eased: the 2Y fell from 4.76 to 4.71 while the 10Y held at 4.96.
Breakevens ticked up for the first time in several sessions: 5Y5Y rose from 2.34 to 2.36 and 10Y from 2.33 to 2.35.
The tracked A-share AI panel closed uniformly lower: all 11 names down, the worst 688525.sh at -5.245 and the best 002156.sz at -2.8344.
Volatility eased a second session, the VIX down to 14.21 from 14.87, while credit widened marginally to a HY OAS of 2.68 from 2.66.
Crypto broke lower: BTC fell -2.94998 to 83241.0, ETH -3.42674 and SOL -3.69597.
Overnight, spot gold fell to 4250 and New York Fed's Williams said another hike by year-end is reasonable, lifting the FedWatch implied rate to 4.205.
watch_next: The FOMC on 2026-09-28 is the next high-importance event: watch whether the committee validates the 4.205 implied rate against the delivered 3.88.
Whether the 2Y's 5 bp retreat extends or reverses, given the front end led while the 10Y held at 4.96.
Whether breakevens keep rising: 5Y5Y at 2.36 and 10Y at 2.35 would turn a real-rate story into an inflation-expectations one.
Whether the A-share AI complex stabilises after all 11 tracked names fell, with 688525.sh at -5.245 the weakest.
Whether credit and volatility finally confirm: at a HY OAS of 2.68 and a VIX of 14.21 they still price no stress.

Whether overnight press reports of a volatility spike reconcile with the fact layer's last close, where the VIX eased: the two readings disagree and the calm-volatility conclusion depends on which one holds.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the front end leads a genuine easing
points: The 2Y fell 5 bp to 4.71 while the 10Y held at 4.96, so the curve steepened to 0.25 without a growth scare.
A VIX of 14.21 and a HY OAS of 2.68 leave room for equities to absorb the rate constraint.
Software and industrials are absorbing the rotation, enterprise software at 1.2646 and industrial automation at 1.58, so the de-rate stays contained to hardware.

base_case.title: Base case: range-bound caution
points: The composite holds near 44.17 with the macro dimension at 68.48 the binding block and the regime unchanged.
The real rate at 2.63 and the 10Y at 4.96 stay at the top of their distributions without forcing a de-rating.
Leadership keeps rotating inside technology rather than leaving it, enterprise software at 1.2646 against semis at -1.9428.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the rate constraint bites
points: A hawkish FOMC on 2026-09-28 that validates the 4.205 implied rate would push the real rate beyond 2.63 and the 10Y beyond 4.96.
Breadth is already thin at 0.6 above MA200 with new lows at 0.0645 exceeding new highs at 0.0258, so a further leg down would be broad.
If the AI hardware de-rate extends, semis -1.9428 and data centers -1.9656, the CN AI complex at all 11 names lower would transmit rather than decouple.
